error.network: The server did not answer. Check your connection.
error.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
error.conflict: This clashes with an earlier change. Reload the page and try again.
error.insufficient_funds: The wallet balance is too low for this.
error.invalid: Some of what you entered is not accepted.
error.state: This cannot be done right now.
error.unavailable: A service this needs (or the 3x-ui panel) did not answer. Try again in a minute.

overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Users, services, revenue and health at a glance.

users.title: Users
users.desc: Find customers, see their services, orders and wallet, ban or unban, adjust balances.

services.title: Services
services.desc: Every subscription with its usage; extend, reset traffic, disable, delete or resync from 3x-ui.

support.title: Support
support.desc: Ticket inbox: reply to customers in the bot, assign tickets, canned replies.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.desc: Send a message to all or some customers, now or later, and follow its progress.

plans.title: Plans
plans.desc: Create and edit plans, traffic packages and the free trial; prices and order.

payments.title: Orders & payments
payments.desc: Orders, payments and the review queue with receipt screenshots; retry provisioning, refunds.

ledger.title: Wallet & ledger
ledger.desc: Every wallet movement, with filters and CSV export.

discounts.title: Discounts & referrals
discounts.desc: Discount codes and their use, the referral reward and top inviters.

resellers.title: Resellers
resellers.desc: Reseller tiers and prices, credit limits, their customers and settlements.

branding.title: Branding & texts
branding.desc: Store name, logo, colors and every bot text in Persian and English.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Payment details, maintenance mode, required channel, rate limits, reminders.

servers.title: 3x-ui servers
servers.desc: Your panels, their health and inbounds, and which plans use which server.

gateways.title: Payment gateways
gateways.desc: Turn gateways on or off, store their keys encrypted, test them.

staff.title: Staff
staff.desc: Who may use the dashboard, their roles, logins and sessions.

system.title: System
system.desc: Health and version of every service, updates, backups and the license.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every change made by staff, searchable and exportable.

placeholder.coming: This section is built in milestone {n} of Phase 4.
placeholder.today: Until then, the bot's /admin panel does this.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Staff dashboard of {brand}
login.link_hint: In your Telegram bot open /admin and tap “Dashboard”. You get a link that logs you in once, within 2 minutes.
login.link_invalid: This login link was used already or has expired. Ask the bot for a new one.
login.locked: Too many failed logins. Wait 15 minutes, or use a link from the bot.
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
login.not_configured: Password logins are off on this install. Use a link from the bot.
login.no_password_yet: A password login is added from My account after logging in with the bot.

overview.failed_hint: Paid orders the panel did not create yet

order.title: Order
order.payments_unavailable: The payments service did not answer; payment attempts are not shown.
order.refund_intro: {amount} goes to the customer's wallet and the order is cancelled (it was not delivered). The customer is told.
order.refund_intro_delivered: {amount} goes to the customer's wallet. The service was delivered and keeps working: delete it on its page if needed. The customer is told.

account.title: My account
account.password_on: On, username {username}. Every login also needs a code from your authenticator app.
account.password_off: Off. You log in with links from the bot.
account.password_intro: A password is a second way in, e.g. when Telegram is unavailable. It always needs a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator…).
account.password_unavailable: Password logins are off on this install (no master key).
account.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand:
account.confirm_code: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows:
account.enabled: Password login is on. Your other sessions were logged out.
account.remove_confirm: Turn off password login? You will then log in only with links from the bot.
account.code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
account.username_taken: Another staff member uses this username.

common.reason_hint: Kept in the audit log with your name.

user.title: Customer
user.adjust_intro: Add money to the wallet or take some out. The customer is told when money is added.
user.ban_intro: A banned customer cannot buy or renew. Their running services keep working until they end (turn them off on their pages if needed).
user.unban_intro: The customer can buy and renew again.

service.title: Service
service.search: Service id, Telegram id, {'@'}username or panel email
service.extend_intro: Add days, traffic or both. It is applied like a renewal (free), and the customer is told.
service.reset_intro: Sets the used traffic back to zero on the panel (a service that had used it all works again).
service.disable_intro: The customer can no longer connect. Renewals and reminders stop until you turn it on again.
service.enable_intro: The customer can connect again; its end date and traffic still apply.
service.delete_intro: Removes the account from the 3x-ui panel for good: the link stops working. The service and its orders stay in the records.
service.done_extend: Extension added: it is applied in a few seconds

plan.intro: Plans are what customers buy in the bot. Traffic packages add traffic to a running service; the free trial is a plan marked as a trial.
plan.name: Plan
plan.trial_hint: Free trial (each customer can take it once)
plan.topup_hint: Traffic package (adds traffic to a running service)

payment.queue_empty: Nothing to review. Card, crypto and Zarinpal-link payments appear here when customers send their receipts.
payment.duplicate_hint: Another receipt has the same reference number. Check the photo carefully: it may be a reused receipt.
payment.approve_intro: Approve this payment of {amount}? The order is paid and delivered at once (or the wallet is topped up).
payment.reject_intro: The customer sees your reason in the bot.

ledger.hint: Every movement of every wallet; money taken out is negative.

discount.code_hint: 3-32 letters, digits, _ or -; customers type it in the bot.
discount.once_per_customer: Each customer can use a code once.
discount.referrals_intro: Customers share an invite link from the bot. When someone they invited makes a first purchase, they get this share of it in their wallet. 0 turns invitations off.
